title: Kernel approximation beyond the native space -- with applications to approximation on manifolds
summary: This article treats kernel approximation and interpolation on embedded manifolds of $\mathbb{R}^N$using restrictions of positive and conditionally positive definite kernels. The main challenge is to develop an approximation theory that treats error measured in highly regular smoothness spaces relative to the kernel. This means that the order of smoothness is higher than that of the kernel's associated native space (in the positive definite case, the reproducing kernel Hilbert space generated by the kernel).
